description: Get ecosystem-level market data (Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Arbitrum, Base, etc.) including market cap, volume, TVL, and performance metrics.

correlation.description: Set to "true" to include correlation data.

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem to return detail for: the config id (e.g. bnb) or the URL slug (e.g. bnb-chain, ethereum, solana). An unknown value returns 400 invalid_parameter listing the valid values.

excludeNative.description: Set to "true" to exclude the native token from aggregated metrics.

name: get_ecosystems

CategoryBasePrices.description: BTC, ETH and SOL price returns from CoinGecko over the six windows, as fractions (-0.0249 is -2.49%), used to re-base category returns into BTC, ETH or SOL terms. There are no USD prices here.

CategorySyncCoverage.description: How many configured categories the last sync refreshed. When a category fetch failed and a previous aggregate existed, the previous rows are served unchanged (`retainedPreviousAggregate`).

avgFundingApr.description: `fundingRate` x 1,095: a fraction a year (0.0493 is 4.93% APR).

fundingRate.description: The coin's funding across venues, 8-hour-equivalent (fraction per 8 hours), open-interest-weighted over each venue's primary contract; null when no venue has a fresh rate.

basePrices.description: `null` when CoinGecko did not return every window for BTC, ETH and SOL; no window reads a fabricated 0.

dominanceMethod.description: How `marketShare` is computed: `share-of-home-chain-market-caps` after a complete sync (`share-of-overlapping-ecosystem-exposures` before 2026-09-30). A sync that kept the previous rows repeats the previous method.

lastAttemptAt.description: When the last sync ran. `updatedAt` stays at the last complete refresh when that run kept the previous rows.

marketCapMethod.description: How `totalEcosystemMcap` and the rows' `marketCap` are computed. `eligible-home-chain-constituents` (since 2026-10-17): the coins whose home chain is the ecosystem and that are eligible: a 24h price change, market cap at least $1M, plausible 24h volume (at most 50x market cap) at least $100K, CoinGecko data under 48 hours old, and not a stablecoin, wrapped, bridged or staked copy, LP token, tokenized metal, fund, stock, ETF or pre-IPO token; the coin table, `coinCount` and every aggregate count that one set. `home-chain-constituents` (2026-09-30 to 2026-10-17): a token CoinGecko files under several ecosystems counts only in its home ecosystem (its native chain, else CoinGecko's primary asset platform), with no market-cap or volume floor on its sums. `deduplicated-fetched-coins`: the earlier method, where a multichain token counted in full in every ecosystem that listed it. A sync that kept the previous rows repeats their method.

status.description: `partial` when at least one category fetch failed in the last sync.

totalEcosystemExposureMcap.description: Sum of the ecosystems' market caps, each token counted in its home ecosystem only: the denominator of `marketShare`.

fundingRate.description: Annualized, a fraction a year (0.0525 = 5.25% APR): the constituents' 8-hour-equivalent funding, weighted by their cross-venue open interest, x 1,095. Not the per-8h fraction the coin rows' fundingRate (and /global's) carry, which is ~1,000x smaller.

marketShare.description: The ecosystem's market cap over `totalEcosystemExposureMcap`, 0 to 1 (0.726 is 72.6%).

mindshare.description: Mindshare merged from the mindshare sync, 0 to 1 (0.1171 is 11.71%), or null when there is no measurement (unmeasured is not 0).

momentumReturn.description: 0.4 x return1h + 0.35 x return24h + 0.25 x return7d, the weights renormalised over the windows present, clamped to -1..1: a fraction (-0.04 is -4%); null when no window is present.

openInterest.description: One-sided open interest across every venue, summed over the constituents' assets (each once).

sentiment.description: Up-vote sentiment merged from the mindshare sync, 0 to 1 (0.692 is 69.2%), or null when there is no measurement (unmeasured is not 0).

watchlistUsers.description: Watchlist users merged from the mindshare sync, or null when there is no measurement (never 0 as a stand-in).

basePrices.description: `null` when CoinGecko did not return every window for BTC, ETH and SOL; no window reads a fabricated 0.

dominanceMethod.description: How `marketShare` is computed: `share-of-home-chain-market-caps` after a complete sync (`share-of-overlapping-ecosystem-exposures` before 2026-09-30). A sync that kept the previous rows repeats the previous method.

lastAttemptAt.description: When the last sync ran. `updatedAt` stays at the last complete refresh when that run kept the previous rows.

marketCapMethod.description: How `totalEcosystemMcap` and the rows' `marketCap` are computed. `eligible-home-chain-constituents` (since 2026-10-17): the coins whose home chain is the ecosystem and that are eligible: a 24h price change, market cap at least $1M, plausible 24h volume (at most 50x market cap) at least $100K, CoinGecko data under 48 hours old, and not a stablecoin, wrapped, bridged or staked copy, LP token, tokenized metal, fund, stock, ETF or pre-IPO token; the coin table, `coinCount` and every aggregate count that one set. `home-chain-constituents` (2026-09-30 to 2026-10-17): a token CoinGecko files under several ecosystems counts only in its home ecosystem (its native chain, else CoinGecko's primary asset platform), with no market-cap or volume floor on its sums. `deduplicated-fetched-coins`: the earlier method, where a multichain token counted in full in every ecosystem that listed it. A sync that kept the previous rows repeats their method.

status.description: `partial` when at least one category fetch failed in the last sync.

totalEcosystemExposureMcap.description: Sum of the ecosystems' market caps, each token counted in its home ecosystem only: the denominator of `marketShare`.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp for populated cache data; an empty string for an empty cache response.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.
